name: component-id
description: For most objects, this is the same as the id range element. It selects objects based on an ID number assigned to an object internally upon creation. For structural elements an ID number refers to a user-defined number identifying a collection of elements. In this case component-id range element refers to the internal unique ID number of the individual object.
official_documentation: Itasca 9.7 shared kernel manual: Range Phrase Keyword Reference
